Just for the record, if one opts for producing a LAP file instead of
the FASL file as the output of the COMPLR, the the runtime of the
compiler seems to be increased about 40%.  This must undoubtably be 
due to the inncreased overhead of character handling in TYO, as
opposed to the word-at-a-time buffering (and simple semantics) of
OUT.
